game.title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2
game.blurb: Online open-world looter shooter and role-playing game from Massive Entertainment and Ubisoft, released 2019-03-15. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Washington, D.C. Main Missions
chapters.summary: The main missions across the city, from the Grand Washington Hotel to the Capitol building.

chapters.title: The Zoo, Camp White Oak and the Pentagon
chapters.summary: Later missions after the Capitol: the zoo, Camp White Oak, the Pentagon and its labs, and two missions with returning agents.

chapters.title: New York and Brooklyn
chapters.summary: The New York missions and manhunt, plus Brooklyn's safe houses, control points, bounties and locations.

chapters.title: Settlements, Control Points and the Open World
chapters.summary: Upgrading settlements, settlement projects, control points, bounties, calls for backup, resource runs and the card suits.

chapters.title: Dark Zones and Conflict
chapters.summary: Safe houses, extractions, rogue agents and hijacks in the Dark Zones, plus skirmish, domination and clan matches.

chapters.title: Raids, Hard Difficulty and Manhunts
chapters.summary: The two eight-player raids, every mission on hard or above, and seasonal manhunts on Challenge.

chapters.title: Levels, Gear and Skills
chapters.summary: Reaching levels 30 and 40, gear, blueprints, exotics, specializations, skills, patches, clans and photo mode.

chapters.title: Combat Tricks
chapters.summary: Tank armour, medics' defibrillators, signature weapons, the crossbow, hood slides and car doors.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 2221490 ("Tom Clancy's The Division® 2") was used; it was the only Steam app-list match. None of the 67 Steam achievements is hidden. RAWG also lists "Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York" (2020) as a separate entry; the New York chapter holds the achievements that name New York, Brooklyn or the targets met there, but which achievements belong to that expansion is not stated in the data. "To Sum It All Up" (Tchernenko and Elijah Sumner) and "You Can't Have Him" (Dolores Jones and Aaron Keener) name no place; they sit between the Pentagon and New York achievements in the Steam list, so they were put with the later missions, a guess that needs checking. "Brooklyn Brains" (use the Smart Cover skill) was put with Brooklyn because of its name. StrategyWiki has "Tom Clancy's The Division 2" at completion stage 0; its Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages are linked but not written, so nothing was used. thedivision.fandom.com answers the API with about 127 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. This is an online game, and several achievements need a group (raids of eight, conflict, clans).
